item.title: Judge blocks rule ending open-ended stays for F-1 students
item.description: A federal judge granted a preliminary injunction against the Department of Homeland Security's final rule fixing the admission period for F-1 students and J-1 exchange visitors. The rulemaking docket lists the comments.

item.title: What the new admission rule means for F-1 students
item.description: Students will be admitted for a fixed length of stay instead of duration of status, under the final rule published in July. Extensions of stay will need an application.

item.title: Universities sue over F-1 student admission limits
item.description: A group of universities filed a lawsuit over limits on how long F-1 students may stay.
